title: Beerta laga eryay
intro: Qof sir ah ayaa mar ku noolaa darajada ugu sarreysa ee abuurka, oo u dhow Ilaahnimada in ka badan inta dad badan fahmi karaan. Haddana kibir baa xididaystay, fal keliya oo diidmo ahna wuxuu beddelay jidka jiritaanka. Hadda, kan wuxuu u wareegayaa sidii cadow dhaaran, isagoo hoos u hadlaya oo shirqoolaya ilaa maalin ballan ah ay timaado. Ma ogaan kartaa aqoonsiga kan dhacay?
clues: Waxaan mar ka mid ahaa kuwa ugu dhow joogitaanka Ilaah, oo ka sarreeya abuurka badan.
Waxaa la iga abuuray curiye guban, oo aan laga abuurin ciid ama dhoobo.
Markii la igu amray inaan u sujuudo abuur cusub, waan diiday — waxaana igu kalifay waxa aan rumaysnaa inay tahay ka sarreyntayda.
Waa la i tuuray oo la i habaaray, laakiin ugu dambeyntii waxaa la i siiyay nasasho ilaa waqti la yaqaan oo la cayimay.
Waxaan ku dhaartay inaan marin habaabinayo intii aan awoodo, anigoo faraca Aadan uga soo dhawaanaya dhinac kasta.
Waxaan ahay cadowga furan, oo lagu dhawaaqay inuu yahay cadowga aadanaha oo dhan, oo had iyo jeer shirqoolaya oo hoos u hadlaya ilaa dhammaadka loo cayimay.

trial.label: Tijaabo / Dhacdo
options: Dhisidda weyl dahab ah oo dadku caabudi karaan
Sidista carshiga Boqoradda Sheba daqiiqad gudaheed

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Nasasho la siiyay ilaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha
Isagoo nool lagu aasay qasri dumay hoostiisa
Wuxuu isu beddelay daanyeer ama daanyeer
outcome.answer: Nasasho la siiyay ilaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
